messages.content: We're taking on 15 more staff at the Martlesham office next month, 35 people in total, and moving everyone to cloud video calls. Our broadband already struggles. What do you suggest?
I recommend upgrading to AgenticTelco Fibre 900 – that’s 900Mbps at £45 per month. Your contract ends 28 August 2027, so that stays the same. Would you like me to go ahead with that?
Great! I’ve got your order reference MVP-DD97C74D. I’ll let you know if anything changes.
Hi Sam, great news! Your AgenticTelco Fibre 900 upgrade is now live, with the service going live on 31 October 2026.
